column3: “Wrath belongs to Yahweh” is rendered “the Lord's indignation,” and “will totally destroy” as “has utterly destroyed.”
“Will melt away from their blood” is rendered “will be drenched with their blood.”
“Will rot away” is rendered “will wear away,” and “the heavens” as “the sky.”
“Will go down” is rendered “shall … fall,” and “will drink its fill” as “shall be soaked.”
“Desert owl” is rendered “pelican,” and “great owl” as “owl”; “stones of emptiness” as “the plumb line of emptiness.”
NASB adds dashes and “Whom they may proclaim king”; the Hebrew is terse.
“Fortresses” is rendered “fortified towers,” and “grass” as “abode,” following a different reading.
“Hyenas” is rendered “wolves,” and “the night-creature” (Lilith) as “the night monster.”
“Owl” is rendered “tree snake,” and “black kites” as “hawks.”
